name: Columbia Edgewater Country Club
architects: A. Vernon Macan (1925); later work by Bob Cupp

dtm.source: DOGAMI lidar DIGITAL_TERRAIN_MODEL_MOSAIC (bare earth; newest project at the course OLC_METRO_3DEP_2019, also OLC_METRO_2014 and COLUMBIA_RIVER_2010_USACE), exportImage at 1 m in EPSG:32610, box x 526800-528300 / y 5048300-5050000, fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-columbia_edgewater)

chm.source: DOGAMI lidar CANOPY_HEIGHT_MODEL_MOSAIC (highest hit minus bare earth), same box and date
chm.label: DOGAMI canopy height model

scorecard_source: Third-party (no card on the club's site found): stymie.golf's card (par, handicap and yardage per hole for every tee set, ratings/slopes), read 2026-11-13; golflink.com's Black row agrees hole for hole. Unverified against a printed card. OSM numbers the nines the other way round (its hole 1 is the card's 10): the card's numbering is used (open item).
attribution: Elevation and canopy height: Oregon Department of Geology and Mineral Industries (DOGAMI) lidar
Orthophoto (checks only): Oregon Statewide Imagery Program 2024
notes: Standing defaults (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1), 2026-11-13: the longest tee set (Black) and it is the default; all water red; OB = the OSM course boundary, roads inside it are cart paths, the driving range is OB; inland Pacific Northwest wind 1-7 mph; trees from DOGAMI lidar, trees in fairways or in the way of a centre-line drive removed and listed. Theme columbia_edgewater (new; the course chat's design).

world.note: OSM course boundary bbox (866 x 1094 m, way/96855100) + at least 120 m of scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred (207 m west/east, 221 m south/north)
